title: One new LA role at Caudalie
intro: One new LA role today: Account Coordinator, USA at Caudalie, the French skincare brand. It's a field job training store teams and managing retail-partner relationships — similar account work to the CHANEL role you liked, and more realistic on experience, though the Wednesday–Sunday store schedule is a real lifestyle tradeoff. Your client and partnerships favorites are all still open.
notes: Today's search covered SMCP, CHANEL, Sol de Janeiro, L'Oréal, L'Occitane, Polène, Caudalie, Coty, Sephora/LVMH, Publicis Groupe agencies (160over90, Team One, Influential), and LinkedIn listings across the LA area.
SMCP Group: Greenhouse shows 56 US/Canada openings. The only non-store role is a New York Boutique Director. No marketing/brand/partnerships roles.
Sol de Janeiro: marketing roles remain New York Metropolitan only (no LA).
L'Oréal El Segundo: #47 Manager, US Marketing (NYX) is still live. Earlier El Segundo roles #1, #3, and #20 now return 404 on L'Oréal's careers site.
CHANEL LA: besides #6, listings are boutique, fashion expertise, and visual merchandising roles.

Also seen but not numbered: LVMH Perfumes & Cosmetics Account Executive, Los Angeles appeared in some LinkedIn search snippets, but no live posting URL could be opened to confirm it. Fairmont Century Plaza Marketing Manager still appears only on aggregators, not on Accor's careers site.

jobs.title: Account Coordinator, USA
jobs.work_arrangement: In the field Wednesday–Sunday (sometimes Tuesday–Saturday); work-from-home 1–2 days a month
jobs.french_tie: Caudalie is a French beauty brand founded in Bordeaux.
jobs.travel: Expected travel up to 50% as per business needs (no destinations named). The posting says you would spend 100% of your time in the field at retail partners.
jobs.why: A field account role at a French skincare house: you'd train store associates, run in-store events, and manage retail-partner relationships to hit sales plans. That relationship and client work is close to the CHANEL fragrance and beauty AE you liked, and they don't require a set number of years — retail cosmetics experience is preferred, not required. The tradeoff is the schedule: Wednesday through Sunday in stores, weekends included, with only 1–2 work-from-home days a month.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Influencer Marketing & Talent Relations (LA Studio)
jobs.location: Los Angeles, CA (Sephora LA Studio, 6824 Lexington Ave)
jobs.french_tie: Sephora is owned by LVMH (Paris HQ).
jobs.why: Brand-side marketing at Sephora's LA studio: you'd run sponsored influencer campaigns end to end, partner with Brand Marketing and agency teams, own the logistics (briefs, trackers, budgets, invoices, reporting), and keep internal stakeholders and outside partners coordinated. The relationship-building and organization from your Gartner work carry over, but it is an influencer-focused job, which you said is lower on your list, so it's ranked below the client and partnerships roles.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years in influencer or social marketing (beauty preferred), and names talent-agency backgrounds (CAA, WME, Gersh, UTA) as ideal.
